text:
maria_g: Heads up — noticed a ~ $9k spike in cloud GPU spend yesterday evening that didn't map to any team in the allocation report.

billing-bot: Alert: GPU spend spike detected (+$8,976) at 2026-01-13 21:42 UTC. Ticket #5421.

jonathan_k: Linking the cost dashboard: https://billing.redwood.ai/reports/2026-01-13?filter=gpu — looks like a lot of unlabeled instances in zone us-west1-b.

sophia_p: Any chance it's reserved-commit rollover or burst capacity from training-prod? I saw autoscaler spin up ~120 vGPUs around that time.

ryan_ops: Quick BQ run shows many rows with NULL allocation_tag. Snippet: ```SELECT COALESCE(allocation_tag,'<unallocated>') AS tag, SUM(cost) AS cost, SUM(gpu_hours) AS gpu_hours FROM `billing.gcp_daily` WHERE date = '2026-01-13' AND product = 'Compute Engine' GROUP BY tag ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 20;```

lisa_fin: If unlabeled, our current finance rule attributes to `unallocated` cost center and it hits the central infra budget. For any customer-facing job we prefer pro-rate back to customers, otherwise it stays with central.

maria_g: Ask: can we run an allocation waterfall for this window: 1) consume reserved commit pools first, 2) allocate by team tags where present, 3) remaining shared-pool pro-rate by gpu_hours per team/customer? Also need to pro-rate any expired promo/credits that overlapped mid-month.

jonathan_k: I can run a backfill that joins instance metadata (labels) and startup-script logs to the billing export and retro-tag where possible. For the pro-rate step I sketched a query and a small pro-rate script:
```python
# pseudo
commit_used = min(commit_capacity, total_gpu_hours)
per_team_share = (team_gpu_hours / (total_gpu_hours - commit_used)) * remaining_cost
```
I'll schedule it to run nightly and surface a provisional allocation table.

sophia_p: Also found a handful of jobs launched with an old image that doesn't set allocation_label. Pushing a patch to the startup script to ensure LABEL=team:<team_name> is baked in.

ryan_ops: I pushed a PR with the BQ query and some example joins: https://git.redwood.ai/billing/allocations/pull/88 — for now if you need to tag immediately, temporarily assign the spike to `ops-sandbox` so dashboards don't show negative budget alerts.

lisa_fin: :thumbsup: Finance will accept a temporary assignment to `ops-sandbox` but we need evidence and the final reclassification once the backfill runs. Please create a PR or ticket with the BQ export and the instance logs used for tagging.

maria_g: Created Asana ticket MG-342 and attached a small CSV export and links to instance logs. I'll drop the CSV here when the backfill finishes. Thanks all.

billing-bot: Note: alert still open, will re-check hourly until MG-342 status set to "resolved".

maria_g: Follow-up: if anyone spots other unlabeled weekend bursts, ping me directly — want to avoid repeat surprises during billing close.
